slides.prompt:
You are an expert-level illustration designer. Please generate a 16:9 vector illustration style presentation slide.

**Visual Style and Art Direction**

Illustration style: Flat Vector Illustration. Must include clear, uniformly thick black outlines (Monoline/Stroke). Color fills should be clean, using only minimal shadows. Gradient colors or 3D rendering effects are strictly prohibited.

Composition format: Horizontal panoramic composition (Panoramic), occupying the top 1/3 of the layout.

Line Work: Must use uniformly thick black single-line strokes (Monoline/Uniform Stroke). All objects must have closed black outlines, similar to coloring book line art style. Line endings should be rounded, avoiding sharp corners.

Geometric Simplification: Simplify complex objects into basic geometric shapes. Aim for a toy model-like cuteness.

Decorative Elements: Add decorative geometric elements in empty spaces, such as radiating lines (representing sunlight or energy), pill-shaped clouds, or simple dots and stars.

**Color Scheme**

Background: Cream/Off-white paper texture base color.

Accent colors: Coral red, mint green, mint green, mustard yellow, burnt orange, and rock blue. Retro and soft tones.

**Typography**

Main title: Large, bold retro serif font (Retro Serif), conveying authority and elegance.

Subtitle: All-caps sans-serif within rectangular color blocks.

Generate a cover page. In the top 1/3 area, draw a horizontal panoramic vector illustration scene, including geometric simplified representations of: an anime-style cute girl character (waifu) with headphones sitting at a computer terminal, code symbols floating around, iTerm2 terminal windows, speech bubbles with musical notes.

Main title uses large retro serif font, content:
Coding Waifu

Subtitle uses all-caps sans-serif within rectangular color block background:
AI-POWERED REAL-TIME CODING COMPANION

Small description text:
Transform your iTerm2 into an immersive coding experience with an animated AI presenter

Background uses cream/off-white paper texture.
